# Packaged renderer licenses

`dist/resvg.wasm` is the unmodified WebAssembly renderer from
[`@resvg/resvg-wasm` 2.6.2](https://github.com/thx/resvg-js/tree/v2.6.2/wasm),
distributed under MPL 2.0. Its license is included as `resvg-MPL-2.0.txt`.
The source code for that release is available at the linked upstream repository.

The packaged Noto Sans KR font has its own SIL Open Font License under `fonts/OFL.txt`.
JavaScript dependencies retain their package licenses and bundled license comments.
